adjusted to

notes.title: A Thankful Words for Endless World Players
notes.notes:
Hey Time Leapers,

Happy New Year! 

2020 is finally gone. Well, this doesn’t have to mean that 2021 would be a much better year, because we all know there are still many things we have to face. But knowing that we can wave goodbye to one of the most terrible years is always a relief. 

In November, we did a Thanksgiving event in the community where some people shared a little bit of their 2020. I’m going to post a couple of them here, and maybe share a little bit about myself. 

I love everything people shared there, and these two hit me well:
“A lot of things going on this year, and lets not pretend those things haven't been tough or hard. My thoughts go out to those who are less fortunate than myself. 
But let’s be thankful for whatever we can be! Hopefully we're all heading towards a more normal year, wherever we live. Call your loved ones often, they might need it more than you think” - Cabinflower

“I'm thankful we are finally getting the orange clown out of office. That we may finally get the virus under control. Thankfully no one in my house has caught it, but both my brother and his wife had it. They both survived, but of course not without new issues after. My house is very high risk. I've basically gone nowhere since March. I'm happy that my puppy is shaping up into a good service dog prospect. My old dog is still in great health and can still work, but she's large breed and 11 years old. She deserves time to be a dog. She's worked almost her entire life. She's been fantastic at it. I'm incredibly lucky I got her when I did. I'm happy I can find a silver lining in this mess.” - Daemon

I love how we always look at the bright side, which is a good thing especially for today. It proves that we human will not fall flat.

At the beginning of last year, I lost my job. Then the virus showed up and forced me to stay home for a few months. The worst thing is, I still had to pay rent for my apartment in the other city. Finding a job was hard since no one wanted to take the risk hiring someone from another city and there weren’t many open positions.

I finally survived by getting a job with Endless World, where I can communicate with players like you. Without you, this job won’t even be here. So, a lot of thanks to all of you who have been here with us.

We sincerely wish you all a great and awesome 2021 and that everything can go back to normal.

Best.

Endless World Team

- Mana Crystal
Some said that Artifacts mean everything. It might not be completely true, but artifacts do have a huge influence on your gameplay. And mana crystal is what you need to unlock those powerful artifacts.

The primary goal of Endless World is to go as far as you can to reach high level floors. Once you reach a floor higher than your last run, you will need to upgrade your equipment. To do that, you will need Dark Iron. And we have these prepared for you.

Once you reach higher levels, you will like Time Keys a lot. The best way to progress fast is to rewind more. And the way to do that is to use more Time Keys. So, those in Shari Mercenary Pack will be a great add-on for you because you usually can only get three time keys each day in the game.

notes.title: Something our Devs Want to Tell You
notes.notes:
Dear Time Leapers,

It’s been a while since Endless World was born. And since that day, this game has become part of our lives. It’s like a little puppy that we adopted. Although it got weird sometimes, like peeing everywhere and causing bugs and issues, it never stopped pleasing us. It always ran and played with itself in the background and bring joy to us. And now, this puppy is one-year old. In that past one year, we made fun of it and we never stopped fixing its problems. But at the same time, we got happy because of it.

As its owners, we kept learning and growing with it. Each day, we listened to your words together. When you pointed out a flaw of the game, we always saw it as a flaw on ourselves. So we would improve ourselves first so that we could apply everything you guys said to the game. That way, we can make it grow into a different and better one. That is why we kept adding more levels into it, and we kept improving features like dungeons and arena. From what the game was like at the beginning, it has grown into a game with lots of new features, like offline progress, league system, rune system, and skill upgrades. We hope that it will completely absorb these features so that they are integrated better in it.

The changes of the whole last year were great, but they have to be greater in the future. Thus we will never stop maintaining it. We will keep working hard. We are considering, that somewhere in the future, we may add a new synergy system, and an Awakening function which helps the players who rewind a lot to get more from it, so that they could enjoy the game better. We made a plan based on all the suggestions we have got from you guys. You will most likely see those changes you want in the game some time. I hope you could keep reporting issues and pointing out its defects. And we will do our best to reduce bugs and increase its stability.

Please remember, what we are pursuing is something you are pursuing as well. We can never go this far without you. Everything you said just perfected us.

We would like to thank you all for that wonderful year. And now, it's time to focus on the future.

Hope you all have fun with us during this Anniversary!

Endless World Team

notes.title: League System is Coming
notes.notes:
Hope you guys were all having fun in the Speed Run this week. And seems like you are all doing well. The new Arena season will start soon. And now, we can get excited about the League System which has been unlocked after yesterday's update.

There are three different types of leagues: League of Goldseekers, League of Hunters, and League of Duelists. 

League of Goldseekers event, Mine Expedition, will start first. And the other two will start in the next two weeks. The three league events will take place on a rotating weekly schedule.

League system are already opened for players to create their own leagues now. You can start inviting others and get ready for the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/6812367b6331f79fcaa267f2241621db5a30255d.jpg[/img]

[b]1. League of Goldseekers[/b]
Each League of Goldseekers can have up to 10 members. Members will take part in the Mine Expedition. 

[b]Unlock Date[/b]
Mine Expedition will be opened first. It will officially start on July 25th. 

Each event lasts 7 days, and closed for 14 days. Each league can register for the event any time during the closed time. After each event starts, players will have 2 hours for matching and 8 hours for preparation. 

[b]Mine Expedition Rules[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/662c7468ffdff4ec968287fcb6a409bcfa0b029b.jpg[/img]

All the leagues will be matched into groups of four. If a group has less than four leagues, these leagues will be added into one of the other groups. So, one group will have mostly seven leagues. 

Each player will choose up to two mercenaries to send for mining. If a mercenary has been sent by one of the other members, then this mercenary cannot be sent again. The higher the level and quality of the mercenaries, the faster they will mine. 

The leader of the league will pick the target. If the target is chosen by other leagues first, league leader will have to choose a different one. Each league can only have one target at one time, and each target will only reward one type of resource. 

During the mining, each league will just wait for the mining team to progress. The amount of rewards will be based on the progress, the number of leagues participating, and the average league level. 

League leader can set bombs at certain targets to disturb enemy leagues’ progress.

[b]Rewards[/b]
Gold Ore – Can be used to reduce the consumption of Coins
Iron Essence – Can be used to reduce the consumption of Dark Iron
Wraithstone – Can be used to reduce the consumption of Soul

[b]2. League of Hunters[/b]
Each League of Hunters can have up to 10 members. Members can take part in Monster Hunting

[b]Unlock Date[/b]
Officially unlocked on August 1st. Each event lasts 7 days, and closed for 14 days. Each league can register for the event any time during the closed time. After each event starts, players will have 2 hours for matching and 8 hours for preparation. 

[b]Monster Hunting Rules[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/a1d68edbd6b8fd8e985ced8135e80f7d3e1d5eaa.jpg[/img]

All the leagues will be matched into groups of four. If a group has less than four leagues, these leagues will be added into one of the other groups. So, one group will have mostly seven leagues. 

During the event, players will face monsters all by themselves while challenging them. 

Each time, there will be 10 monsters for players to challenge. Players shall pick the monsters based on their difficulty. The harder the monsters are, the more rewards players will get. Players will have limited number of chances to challenge. Each failure will cost a chance. But they can challenge the same monster multiple times.

Each monster can only be challenged by one player at one time. Players need to pick the monsters fast in case someone else beats them fist. Monsters that got beaten will be refreshed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/5fb6bf3fecc47baca6e3f8c1449f185f3d288d8d.jpg[/img]

Each monster has some elemental resistance. Using the mercenaries with restrained element will help reduce the difficulty.

[b]Rewards[/b]
Players will get rewarded with skillbooks. Skillbooks can be used to upgrade the skills of mercenaries and main character’s artifacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/249e60aa25ba648eb40dc3c7d1f81f0cc63320d4.jpg[/img]

[b]3. League of Duelists[/b]
Each League of Duelists can have up to 20 members. Members can take part in League Supremacy.

[b]Unlock Date[/b]
Officially unlocked on August 8th. Each event lasts 9 days, and closed for 12 days. Each league can register for the event any time during the closed time. After each event starts, players will have 2 hours for matching and 8 hours for preparation. Event of League of Duelists will have two days overlay with the event of League of Goldseekers.

[b]League Supremacy Rules[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/146251e5476fe660dc4612fe52ce7d55904d3557.jpg[/img]

Each event matches 6 leagues together for a tournament. Each two leagues will fight each other. 

Each player will have some points when the event starts. During the event, each player can pick an enemy player to attack. If he wins, he will get one point, and if he fails, he loses one. Players with 0 point can still be challenged, but the challengers will not earn any point if they win.

League leaders can assign a general and three vice generals during the preparing phase. Challengers who beat them will get more points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/e58855447a5d84453165d53e40785cddb46adba9.jpg[/img]

[b]Elemental Refine[/b]
Elemental Stats are special stats for League of Duelists. Players can refine these stats in the element page of main character and mercenaries. Glory Medals can be used to increase the damage and resistance of an element. Unity Medals can be used to increase Accuracy and Dodge. 

Please note that elemental damage can only work for mercenaries with the same elements. For example, if you want to refine elemental stats for Eva, who is a water element mercenary, then refining elemental damage of any element other than water would be pointless. There is no such limitation on elemental resistance. 

[b]How is the winner decided?[/b]
1. Leagues with more points will win
2. If two leagues have the same number of points, the one whose general gets more points will win
3. If the generals’ points are again the same, then the system will take a look at the total points of all the vice generals.
4. If everything is the same, then it’s a draw game. (Loss for both team, and no extra points for either league)

[b]Rewards[/b]
Participating in League Supremacy will reward players with Glory Medals, Unity Medals, and Shimmering Sundew. Glory Medals and Unity Medals can be used for elemental refine.


If you have any thought or suggestion for Arena, Speed Run, and the coming League System, please leave a message to let us know.

notes.title: New Speed Run Season will Start Soon
notes.notes:
Dear Time Leapers,

Did you have fun in Arena this week? The new Speed Run system will be here this coming Saturday. Arena and Speed Run will happen alternatively each week. That means, this Arena season is about the end when the first season of Speed Run starts. 

You all still have a couple days to fight your way to the top in Arena.

To get prepared for the Speed Run season, let take a look at the most updated rules:

[b]1.New Speed Run Rules[/b]
When to start: 
New sprint games will become weekly events. Instead of starting after each rewind, players will start on a fixed time each season. 

Who will play: 
After a player register in a division, the system will automatically match him with other players who pick the same time and have a similar Team Strength.

What to get: 
Diamonds, Souls, Hero Medals, Dragonscales, Mana Crystals, and Treasure Maps

Who will win: 
Sprint result will be based on the highest level of a player during the season.
 
[b]2.A New Feature[/b]
Players will be asked to pick a camp to join. In the camp, players can get cards to increase stats of their mercenaries. Then, players’ team strength will be increased. That will help them to get to higher levels with a faster speed. 

[b]What are the Camps?[/b]
There will be a total of 6 camps for players to choose from. Water, fire, wind, earth, light, and dark. Each element represents a camp. Player in a camp of an element can only get cards of that same element.

Pick a camp
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/337fd1824e7efba60d5d018a2ad63bcc1d0228fd.jpg[/img]

[b]What are the Cards?[/b]
Cards can be defined by a combination of mercenaries, classes, and the element of the camp. Each card can provide 3 skills:
1.Passive skill: If the player owns the mercenary as what he gets on the card, then this mercenary will have his damage, defense, and health enhanced. Can get stacked.
2.Passive skill: The player’s mercenaries of the same class as the card will all have their attack enhanced. Can get stacked.
3.Active skill: Increases all the stats of the mercenaries of the same class as the one on the card for a limit time. No stack.

Ex. Supposed that you join the water camp and get the card of Arnaud the warrior, then there are 3 skills you will get:
1.If you have Arnaud on your team, his attack, defense, and health will be enhanced.
2.All the warriors on your team will get their attack enhanced.
3.If you activate the card, all the warriors you own will have all their stats enhanced for a limit time.

[b]How to get Cards?[/b]
To get a good rank in a sprint event, players will want to get as many cards as possible. There are 3 ways players can get cards:

1.When a player joins a camp at the beginning of a sprint, he will get a card of the same element of the camp.
2.Each time a player rewinds, he will get a card of the same element as the camp he is in.
3.Players can win camp games to get cards of the same element as the camp he is in.

[b]How to win a camp game?[/b]
Every few hours in a sprint, the system will do a quick comparison for the numbers of players each camp has. In these two situations, a camp will be the winner:

1.There is only 1 player in it.
2.The number of players in this camp is less than the camp with the weaker element.

Ex. Supposed that there are 10 players in the fire camp. The wind camp, which has the weaker element, has 20 players in it. Then, because the fire camp has less players, it will be the winner of the camp game. And players in the fire camp will each get a card of fire element.

Decide the winner camps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33309058/0bda7801d0ed3d6e591957b553acccd31257ee41.jpg[/img]

Players can switch to different camps. There will be a cool down between every two switching. Players will need to pick the camp carefully based on the classes and elements of the mercenaries on their teams.

We are looking forward to seeing your performance in the new Speed Run season.

League will be unlocked on July 25th as we planned. This will be a great time to get ready for it. Make sure you get your friends to join your league.

notes.title: Get Ready for the Arena Ladder!
notes.notes:
Three of the most important update in the new expansion are Arena Ladder, New Sprint System, and the League (Guild) System. After the update today, players will be able to play pvp battles in the new Arena system first. Those who love pvp should use this chance to get higher rank, enhance their team strength, and beat each other up. 

The new Arena would be a good place for players to prove themselves and get plenty of resource for important things like Direct Mercenary Switching and Quality Upgrade.

[b]1）Daily Participation[/b]
After each match, players will get a reward, either Arena Coins or Blessing Scrolls. Each player will get 5 rewards each season. A total of 500 Arena Coins and 35 Blessing Scrolls.

[b]2）Rank Rewards[/b]
In a season, every time a player reaches a higher rank, he will get a rank rewards. The rewards that are available are Arena Coins, Blessing Scrolls, and Master Badges

[b]3）Seasonal Rank Rewards[/b]
After a season ends, our system will send the post season rank rewards
Bronze and Silver：Diamonds
Gold：Diamonds and Blessing Scrolls
Diamond：Diamonds, Blessing Scrolls, and Hero Badges
Master：Diamond, Blessing Scrolls, Hero Badges, and Master Badges

[b]4）Arena Shop[/b]
Players can spend Arena Coins buying things in Arena Shop to get Souls, Dark Irons, Mercenary Shards, Pickaxes, Blessing Scrolls, Glory Medals, and Unity Medals.


In the new expansion, Arena and Sprint take place alternatively each week. So, after the first week, on July 18th, players will be able to attend a new sprint system event. 

After you have experienced those two, you will have a better insight of you and other players’ performance. It would give you some ideas about who you want to invite to form leagues. And so that you know how to prepare for the league events. The whole league system will be unlocked on July 25th.

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 7 – Arena Ladder
notes.notes:
Getting tired of running around and beating bosses all the time? Everyone wants to become one of the legends in Endless World, and here it is, a new Arena Ladder System will be here to make your dream come true. You will have your chance to be the best and earn lots of rewards like Blessing Scrolls and Master Badges.

[b]How to Play[/b]
There will be a new arena season every two weeks, and each one will last for about a week.

- Match
During each season, players can hit the match button in the Arena page to challenge other players. Each match costs 1 Arena Ticket. The number of Arena Tickets will increase by 1 after each hour. Players can also purchase them with diamonds. It will be 20 diamond for each ticket. Each player can hold 10 tickets in hands mostly.

After a player gets matched with another, he won’t be able to switch artifacts and change mercenaries in his team. The same enemy won’t appear again in the next 3 matches.

Match (Developing)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/FD7s2Jq/match.png[/img]

- Popular Mercenaries Banned
After a season, the most used mercenaries will be banned for the next two seasons. The 2nd, 3rd, and 4th most used ones will be banned for one season.

Mercenaries Banned (Developing)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/S7LcSpP/banned-mercenaries.png[/img]

For instance
Supposed that, after the 1st season, the five most used mercenaries are A, B, C, D, and E (from high to low). Then, in the next season, mercenaries A, B, C, and D will be banned. 

After the 2nd season, supposed the five new mercenaries used the most are F, G, H, I, and J, then the banned B, C, and D will be replaced by F, G, and H. The banned mercenaries now will be F, G, H, and A. 

Now you can see, A will be banned for another season, while B, C, and D only get banned for one season. 

So, after the 3rd season, G, H, and A will be replaced by new ones. And F will be banned for another season because he was the one that was used the most.

- Rank
Every time a player beats an enemy, he will get scores. And if he fails, he loses some. When his score reaches a certain point, he will get into a higher rank.

There are a total of 5 ranks, they are Bronze (I, II, III), Silver (I, II, III), Gold (I, II, III), Diamond (I, II, III), and Master. Those with the Master rank are pretty much the best Endless World players.

Please note that your Lunar Power will not affect your battles in Arena anymore.

[b]Rewards[/b]
In arena, players can get a lot of useful resources. There are mainly 4 different ways to get them:

Daily Participation、Rank Rewards、Seasonal Rank Rewards, and Arena Shop

1）Daily Participation
Daily Participation (Developing)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/LRKZ22t/daily-participation.png[/img]

After each match, players will get a reward, either Arena Coins or Blessing Scrolls. Each player will get 5 rewards each season. A total of 500 Arena Coins and 35 Blessing Scrolls.

Arena Coins can be spent in Arena Shop to get items. Blessing Scrolls can be used to increase mercenaries’ quality.

2）Rank Rewards
Rand Rewards (Developing)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/HBghTZq/rank-rewards.png[/img]

In a season, every time a player reaches a higher rank, he will get a rank rewards. The rewards that are available are Arena Coins, Blessing Scrolls, and Master Badges

Master Badges can be used for Mercenary Switching

3）Seasonal Rank Rewards
Seasonal Rank Rewards (Developing)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/PT6x3QX/seasonal-rank-rewards.png[/img]

After a season ends, our system will send the post season rank rewards
Bronze and Silver：Diamonds
Gold：Diamonds and Blessing Scrolls
Diamond：Diamonds, Blessing Scrolls, and Hero Badges
Master：Diamond, Blessing Scrolls, Hero Badges, and Master Badges

Hero Badges can be used for both regular Mercenary Switching and the New Merc Switching

4）Arena Shop
Arena Shop (Developing)

Items available in Arena Shop: Souls, Dark Irons, Mercenary Shards, Pickaxes, Blessing Scrolls, Glory Medals, and Unity Medals.

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 6 – Elemental Damage/Resistance Up
notes.notes:
Have you ever had this feeling? Supposed that you are in a PVP battle and you have a good team with perfect mercenaries. But your enemy has a few mercs that has better elements. Then you have a tough fight and maybe even lose the whole battle.

To make PVP more fun to play and to let players think more about PVP strategies, we decided to add a few stats that can be boost.

In our first preview, we mentioned these new PVP stats for a little. Today, I will give you some updates and more details.

[b]New Stats[/b]
Endless World already has an element restrain system：
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rw6k7HP/element-retrain-1.png[/img]

In the new function, we will add three brand new stats:
1）Elemental Attack
Increase the protagonist’s attack with a specific element. There a total of 6 stats, one for each element

Elemental Attack（Devs screen）
[img]https://i.ibb.co/sPG231r/elemental-attack1.png[/img]

2）Elemental Resistance
Increase the protagonist’s elemental resistance. Also 6 of them, one for each element

Elemental Resistance（Devs’ screen）
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zZBNZfW/elemental-resistance1.png[/img]

3）Attention (This name might change)
There are 2 of them. Increase dodge and accuracy.

Attention（Devs’ screen）
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZHmgtMh/attention1.png[/img]

[b]Stats Boost[/b]
When players get enough resource, they can go to role page and then element page. Then they pick the one they want to boost and use medals to upgrade.

1）Honor Medals
Used to increase elemental attack and elemental resistance. Players can get this by doing events in a PVP guild.

Elemental Attack Refine（Devs’ Screen）
[img]https://i.ibb.co/pnFbLxQ/elemental-attack2-refine.png[/img]

2）Unity Medals
Used to increase dodge and accuracy. Also acquired by doing PVP guild events.

Attention Refine（Devs’ Screen）
[img]https://i.ibb.co/mqLQFYZ/attention2-refine.png[/img]

[b]Actual Effect[/b]
With this new function, players can let mercenaries deal damage of different elements, increase their resistance on other elemental attack, and increase their dodge and accuracy.

For instance, supposed that a player has a water-element Eva on his team as the main DPS. The enemy team, however, has a couple of earth-element mercenaries. Then, Eva will be restrained.

With elemental attack and resistance boost, Eva will be able to do a much better job. Let’s say, the player can give her a wind-element attack and earth-element resistance. Then, Eva will be able to deal large amount of damage to enemy’s earth mercenaries while she also resists a lot of their damage.

The new stats are a total of 14. They will affect mostly PVP battles and have almost no effect on PVE. Players who love competition will find this quite useful to enhance their team with stats boost. They can think about what elemental stats they need to deal maximum damage to their enemies.

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 5 - Mercenary Quality Up
notes.notes:
Are you troubled by the fact that a mercenary is very powerful but because of their base rarity their stats suffer? For example, if you have a Feu, you are amazed by her dps, but even if she reaches a high evolution, her purple base rarity quality stats always seem to be worse than that of orange legendary rarity mercenary.

In order to reduce this injustice against and allow players to maintain their original intentions for each of their favorite mercenaries, we decided to add the mercenary quality enhancement function. Players will be able to change the color of the mercenaries (and boost their stats as a result) and break through the quality barrier of mercenaries.

Naturally in this new function, each mercenary must reach the corresponding star to increase their quality. For example, a blue mercenary needs 4 stars to be upgraded to purple. 

Increasing the quality of mercenaries will increase their basic attributes. So be sure to do it when you get a chance. We will also adjust the corresponding value of the current low-quality mercenaries to ensure that their attributes when reaching the highest quality will not be too far from the existing mercenaries.

A new resource will be added where the blessing scroll will be used to upgrade the mercenaries’ quality. This resource is mainly obtained through arena rewards, but also from daily rewards, rank rewards and season settlement rewards. 

When upgrading to different qualities, different quantities are consumed. For example, upgrading from blue to purple requires only 1,000 blessing scrolls, and from purple to orange may require 3000 blessing scrolls. We may improve the upper limit of mercenary quality, which means that there may be higher mercenary quality than the legendary orange. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tzbdyKH/20200615133847.png[/img]


So, let's go back to Feu's example. At present, with the purple quality of Feu, although the damage is particularly high, many players are still more willing to choose Eva. Eva, as a five-star orange quality mercenary, has a relatively higher basic attribute bonus.

With the function of quality improvement, Feu will gain higher strength value than before. After rising to orange quality, the improvement of her basic attributes will make her total combat power increase.

In addition, some mercenaries with blue rarity stats, such as the mercenaries that some players also like very much, such as Afra, Squall and Moss, will also be able to get more opportunities to play.

In short, the improvement of mercenary quality will increase the value of all mercenaries, and players will have more choices, thereby indirectly improving the balance between different mercenaries. Players can look forward to this new feature.

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 4 - Rune System
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We previously introduced the upgrade of mercenary skills, which can help the protagonist’s team to become stronger. But what about the protagonist? Well, in order to allow the protagonist to be strengthened alongside mercenaries as the level increases, we will allow the artifact skills to be strengthened. 

Therefore, we present, the rune system.

[b]What does the rune system do?[/b]

1) Upgrade artifact skills
Runes can be used to change and improve the effect of skills. Players will be able to equip runes on artifact skills to gain an ability. Each skill can only be equipped with one rune.

There are two main types of runes:
- Normal: can enhance skills against enemies and most bosses in general.
- Specific: can largely enhance players’ skills against specific bosses or when matched with specific lineups, but the mismatching has negative effects

Rune effects based on the types of effects:
- Offensive types: enhance the offensive aspect of the skill, such as additional damage, increasing the attack range, etc.
- Defensive types: enhance the defensive aspect of the protagonist, such as improving the evasion rate, restoring life, etc.

In order to make everyone better understand, I will use the sword of annihilation as an example to showcase the rune effects. Note that this is still only the planned effect, and the content in the actual data sheet may be slightly different:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/g9PrwD0/en1.jpg[/img]
Sword of Annihilation

Sword of Annihilation has three active skills, and each skill will have 5 types of runes to choose from:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/yhm6M3q/en2.jpg[/img]


2) Permanent Passive Artifact Bonus
Every rune you unlock gives its corresponding artifact a passive boost regardless if the rune itself is equipped or not. The attributes that get upgraded are either damage bonus or damage reduction depending on which artifact it is.

From the example for sword of annihilation, we see that an artifact can have a total of about a dozen runes that can be equipped. If the player is able to unlock all the runes for sword of annihilation, the damage bonus gained will be very impressive.

[b]How to get runes[/b]

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 3 – New Sprint System
notes.notes:
Last time, we introduced Skill Upgrades and a New Merc-Switching System. Besides these new features, we will also make adjustments to the old ones so that they can be more playable. This time, we will introduce a new sprint system.

We will make some changes to the rules of sprint, so that it is more playable and competitive. 

[b]New Sprint Rules [/b]

1) Starting Time: 
New sprints will become weekly events. Instead of starting after each rewind, players will start on a fixed time each week. There will be a few different starting times for players to choose from. So, players can decide for themselves when they want to start a sprint.

2) Who will be in your sprint: 
After a player picks a starting time, the system will automatically match them with other players who pick the same time and have a similar Lunar Power/Team Strength.

3) What are the rewards: 
All the original types of resources that players currently get as rewards (rate may be different), and we are also considering adding new resources which players can use alongside the other new stuff in the upcoming expansion.

4) Who wins: 
Sprint results will still be based on how far in the maps that players reach. But be aware, now if you rewind during a sprint event, your sprint progress will also reset with it.


[b]A New Sprint Feature[/b]

In the new sprint system, we will add some new stuff too. Players will be asked to pick a camp to join. In these camp, players can get cards to increase stats of their mercenaries. Then, players’ team strength will be increased. That will help them to get to higher levels with a faster speed. Note that these cards aren't like the mercenary cards players get from Taverna. 

What are Camps?

There will be a total of 6 camps for players to choose from. Water, fire, wind, earth, light, and dark. Each element represents a camp. Players in a camp of an element can only get cards of that same element.

Players pick a camp
[img]https://i.ibb.co/wcWrzs1/2.jpg[/img]


What are the Cards?

Cards can be defined by a combination of mercenaries, classes, and the element of the camp. Each card can provide 3 skills:
-Passive skill: If the player owns the mercenary as displayed on the card, then this mercenary will have all their stats enhanced. (Does not stack)
-Passive skill: All the player’s mercenaries that match the class on the card will have the same one of their stats enhanced. (Does not stack)
-Active skill: Increases all the stats of the mercenaries of the matching class as the one on the card for a limited time. This consumes the card, disabling passive benefits. (Active effect can be stacked)

Ex. Suppose that you join the water camp and get a card with Arnaud the warrior on it, then there are 3 skills you will get:
-If you have Arnaud on your team, his stats will all be enhanced.
-All the warriors on your team will get the same one of their stats enhanced .
-If you activate the card, all the warriors you own will have all their stats enhanced for a limited time.

How to get Cards?

To get a good rank in a sprint event, players will want to get as many cards as possible. There are 3 ways players can get cards:

- When a player joins a camp at the beginning of a sprint, he will get a card of the same element of the camp.
- Each time a player rewinds, he will get a card of the same element as the camp he is in.
- Players can win camp games to get cards of the same element as the camp he is in.

How to win a camp game?

Every few hours in a sprint, the system will do a quick comparison of the number of players each camp has. In these two situations, one camp will be the winner:

-There is only 1 player in it. 
-The number of players in this camp is less than the camp with the weaker element.

Ex. Supposed that there are 10 players in the fire camp. The wind camp, which has the weaker element, has 20 players in it. Then, because the fire camp has less players, it will be the winner of the camp game. And players in the fire camp will each get a card of fire element.

Decide the winning camps.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Jn0y2pF/1.png[/img]


To get more strategies involved in the new sprint, we will allow players to switch among different camps. There will be a cooldown time between every two switches. Players will need to pick the camp carefully based on the classes and elements of the mercenaries on their teams.

After the adjustments, the sprint system will be much more fun to play. New features will bring more possibilities and playabilities. It definitely deserves your expectation.

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 2 – New Merc-Switching System and Skill Upgrade
notes.notes:
I hope our last preview of the guild system has given you guys something to expect. I am going to introduce 2 more very essential functions that will also be in the next expansion of the game.

[b]New Merc-Switching System[/b]

To reduce the cost of merc changing for players’ team, we decided to adjust our current switching system. Instead of switching to random mercs, players will finally be allowed to switch a merc to any merc they want. 

What players need to do is to get a new item called Scroll of Blessing from PVP arena. Then they can use scrolls of blessing and hero medals to switch mercs to their target ones.

Except those ones which are only available in specific events, players can do switching with all the mercs. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/jWQq1cd/1.jpg[/img]
                                                    Pick Your Target Merc (Still developing)

There will be a few rules:
1. Once you do switching to a merc, you can’t turn it back.

2. A merc can be switched to a merc with same level, same rank, and same or lower quality.

Ex. A level 1, 5-moon Vonil (gold quality), can be switched to a level 1, 5-moon Lily (purple quality), or to a level 1, 5-moon Andre (blue quality).

3. The target merc’s quality must be lower than the switching merc’s rank. (See gold quality as 5 stars, purple as 4 stars, and blue as 3 stars, then compare it with rank)

Ex 1. A 4-star Feu (purple) can be switched to a 4-star Kukbar (purple), but can’t be switched to a 5-star Vonil (gold). Because Vonil’s gold quality (5 stars) is higher than Feu’s rank (4 stars).

Ex 2. A 5-moon Feu (purple) can be switched to a 5-moon Kukbar (purple), and can also be switched to a 5-moon Vobil (gold). Now it’s because Vonil’s quality (5 stars) is lower than Feu’s rank (5 moons).

So, basically, if you train a merc to a rank higher than 5 stars, you can switch him to any other merc you want. 


[b]Skill Upgrade[/b]

Have you ever thought about how weird it is seeing “level 1” in the icon of each skill but can’t actually level it up? We are going to change that.

When the next expansion comes out, players will be able to level up artifacts’ and mercs’ skills. Each skill can get to a highest of level 6.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/s9c7dNF/20200602193617.png[/img]
                                                     Merc Skill Upgrade (still developing)

Skill upgrade will need skill books. We have talked about this in the guild system preview. Players will need to attend a PVE guild event to get skill books. When a skill is in a higher level, it will require higher-level skill books to level up.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/dKZgbSf/3.jpg[/img]
                                                      Artifact Skills Upgrade (still developing)

When a player downgrades a merc, all the resources used to level him up will be returned to the player. If a merc is used to evolve another one, the resources used on him will be returned as well

Also, we will add four more passive skills for each merc. So each merc will have a total of eight skills. At the same time, we are considering adding a rune system for artifacts. Each artifact will have 5 sockets for runes. 

This is all we have so far for the new merc-switching system and skills upgrade. If you have any suggestions or if there is anything you don’t like about them, please let us know on discord.

notes.title: Summer Expansion Preview 1 - Guild System
notes.notes:
For a long while, we have been thinking about how to integrate a promising guild system into our idle game, Endless World. There are two things we were concerned with. We can’t offer a gameplay like an mmorpg because this is an idle game, but we also do not want players to still feel separated from each other after they join a guild. Therefore, we decided to let players team up and compete with other guilds. This way, we can still create a connection among players while still keeping the afk features. 

The current plan is to add three different types of guilds into the game. There will be different types of events and activities depending on which type of guild you join. And the prizes will be different as well. We haven’t had the official names for them yet. Let’s just call them Resource Guilds, PVE Guilds, and PVP Guilds, for now.

Each player can join a maximum of three guilds, one of each type.

[b]1.PVE Guild：[/b]
In a PVE guild, players can take part in Team Hunting. After the hunting, they will be rewarded with skill books which can be used to level up skills. 

Wait, we can’t level up skills, right? If you ask this question in your heart, you are definitely one of the most loyal players we currently have. Thank you very much for staying with us. 

So, you will finally be able to level up the skills of yours and your mercenaries’. And joining a PVE guild will be the best way to get the material for that. 

Most monster hunting quests in other idle games would normally let players play all by themselves. We kept thinking about those quests in AFK Arena. In that game, joining a guild merely means that you have an opportunity to do one or two single-player quests to get equipments.

In Endless World, a player will challenge monsters together with guild members. It will require them to get in connect and communicate with each other. Players will still face a monster alone, but if they fail, they would still get awards if other members win.

Monsters will be powerful bosses. They usually carry some buff which will either decrease the damage it takes from a specific element or become completely immune to that element. The buff depends on the element of the boss, so players will need to pick their mercenaries carefully.

Each event, there will be 10 quests refreshed. Players need to make the decision to choose a monster to challenge based on the difficulty they can take. Harder monsters will bring more rewards. Players will have multiple tickets to challenge monsters until they run out.

Again, each monster has their own element. Sending the right mercenary to fight is more important than ever.


[b]2.PVP Guilds：[/b]
We know a lot of players love PVPs. So, we would add guilds for PVP only into the game. Players with more power just need to beat other guild’s players.

Players in a PVP guild will try to get more points from GVG battles. We will compare the points between the two guilds to decide the winner.

There are new attributes for PVP Guilds events gained through rewards after PVP events.
6 element damages, 6 element immunities, 1 to boost hit rate, and 1 to increase dodge rate. 

Each PVP guild can have up to 20 members. Each event will match 6 guilds together for a round-robin tournament. Each round will divide them into groups of 2 to fight.

During the preparations, the guild owner will select a general and 3 colonels. If guild owner doesn’t finish the selection, the system will assign the roles based on the player’s team strength. Both players and guilds will get points from winning each battle and lose some if they lose.

Each guild can have 1 general and 3 colonels.
General starts with 60 points. Each loss will cost 6.
Colonels each has 45 points. Each loss will cost 5.
Other members each has 9 points. Each loss will cost 3 points.

Preparation time starts right after the beginning of each round. The system will later assign an enemy guild from one of the 5 guilds. After the round starts, players will pick an enemy player to battle with. There will be a limited number each player can challenge an enemy.

After each event, players will be rewarded with honor medals and team medals. They can be used to buy essence to upgrade your PVP combat power. Essence can be used like an extra equip slot. The MC and Merc can each equip one essence. Once a mercenary equips an essence in a socket, it can’t be taken off. You replace it with a new one but the old one will be lost. Essence will boost their resistance to an element or deal more damage with a type of element. Alternatively, it increases the dodge or hit rate.

The number of medals an essence costs depends on the level of the essence.
Honor Medals – Can be used to exchange for element damage and element resistance essences
Team Medals – Can be used to exchange for hit rate and dodge rate essences


[b]3.Resources Guilds：[/b]
Players can take part in the team exploration to get lots of rewards. Other than the original four resources - gold, dark iron, souls, and time energy, there will be three new resources for players to get. Exploration with the resources guilds will be the only way to acquire them.

The three new resources are：Crude Gold、Refined Dark Iron、Soul Crystal
They can help players boost their team strength more efficiently.

Crude Gold – Can be used to upgrade the five major attributes
Refined Dark Iron – Reduce the dark iron required for equips customizing, crafting, and advanced fusing.
Soul Crystal – Can reduce the souls required for mercenary upgrading

In Resources Guilds’ exploration, a player’s guild will be matched with multiple other guilds. Each player in the guild can dispatch 1 or 2 mercenaries to the guild team. You can’t dispatch the same mercenaries if they are dispatched by other players already. 

Before the exploration, the guild owner will pick a route they want to explore. If the route is taken already, the guild owner will have to reselect one. Each guild can only do one route each time and each route will only reward one type of resources.

The guild’s “progress” will increase as time passes. When “progress” is filled, the exploration will finish. Each player’s individual reward will be counted based on the “progress” he contributes for the guild. 

To make it more playable and competitive, there will be bombs to use. Guild owners can bury a bomb in a route. The guild on that route which touch the bomb will have to wait extra hours before finishing their “progress”.

The three different types of guilds will use different methods to benefit players. Each one of them retains the idle gameplay. Guild system will become a reality in about a month. The actual content we have by then will be much better than what is shown in this preview. Keep your expectations high. Also, please keep telling us your thoughts and suggestions.
